quotes.text: The Clang 18 follow-up uses -no-pie for all compilers and leaves it in OS_LIBS so it comes after MOZ_PROGRAM_LDFLAGS -pie. The prior clang-specific -nopie branch was removed. D210720 was accepted, then the paired Clang 18 ports were backed out and relanded as upstream state changed. This is a file-specific link-order contract, not a general preference for OS_LIBS.
